description: A process: numbered cards joined by arrows, lit one at a time, with a sentence for the active step.
useWhen: An ordered process of 2 to 5 stages. For branches or loops, write a custom scene.

long.title: From a pull request to production, with every check along the way
long.caption: Each stage must pass before the next one is allowed to start.

steps.label: Open a pull request
steps.detail: A developer proposes a change and asks the rest of the team to look at it before anything else happens.

steps.label: Run the automated tests
steps.detail: The pipeline builds the project and runs every test, so reviewers only ever see changes that already work.

steps.label: Review by a teammate
steps.detail: Someone else reads the code, asks questions and either approves it or requests changes from the author.

steps.label: Merge to the main branch
steps.detail: Once approved and green, the change joins the main branch and becomes part of the next release automatically.

steps.label: Deploy to production
steps.detail: The new version reaches a small share of users first and, if the metrics look healthy, then reaches everyone.
